NeuroVisio

NeuroVision is a research platform exploring how spaceflight-related ocular changes, fluid dynamics, and tissue mechanics can advance understanding of optic nerve health and future regeneration research.

My inspiration is deeply personal: my daughter lost an eye to retinoblastoma. Her journey gave me a dream—to contribute to scientific advances that may one day help restore vision. I created NeuroVision to bring space science, engineering, and neuroscience together toward that hope.
